prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet of EXACTLY the existing painted Greek warrior in the single reference. This reference is the only visual authority; animate THIS man without redesigning, overmuscling, simplifying or making him younger. Twelve separate full-body drawings on regular4-column x3-row grid. Same three-quarter front LEFT orientation and slightly elevated isometric camera as reference, with consistent height/scale.
IDENTITY precision: slender athletic adult with narrow shoulders and a slim three-quarter torso, original mature angular face and straight nose, same relatively small golden helmet and compact red crest. Copy warm ivory smooth chest plate with restrained original contour divisions, two gold shoulder clasps and petrol-teal straps. Not barrel-chested, no inflated bodybuilder abdominal lobes, no huge biceps, not big-headed/chibi. Bare arms are naturally tapered, original gold greaves slim, brown sandals modest. Exact dark petrol teal pleated skirt and tiny gold border, red belt/sash, ivory warm plate, original face colors. Preserve the original fine warm-dark outline and soft planar shading; no thick black comic outlines. Ensure all twelve poses look exactly like reference when seen at 200px body height.
EQUIPMENT during these bow actions: same original spear is strapped on back at a slight angle, same original teal Lambda shield with gold edge is strapped on back, its outer emblem face seen obliquely in this front-left view. In hands a slender traditional curved wooden Greek bow, aiming toward screen-left; bow held in LEFT hand, string pulled/released by RIGHT. Simple equipment size consistent with the original. No new ornaments, clothing or effects.
ROW1, four precision-shot frames with right/rear knee planted on ground, left/front knee up, front foot planted screen-left. This is visibly kneeling and shorter than standing rows. Columns1-4: (1) drawing toward cheek, one arrow nocked; (2) full draw, bowarm extended left, taut continuous string, one arrow; (3) release, NO ARROW, right fingers OPEN by cheek, string relaxed but still continuously joining both tips; (4) followthrough, right hand slightly outward, no arrow, bowaim unchanged.
ROW2, four power-shot frames in low wide standing stance, both soles planted at their proper iso depths, torso braced yet same slender original anatomy, no exaggerated muscular transformation. Same four columns: near-full draw arrow, full draw arrow, open-hand release no arrow, followthrough no arrow.
ROW3, four upward volley frames, upright planted stance, bow lifted diagonally toward upper-left rather than horizontal. The man remains same height and lean proportions as the original. Same four columns: near-full draw with THREE nocked arrows, full draw with THREE arrows, release with NO arrows and open hand, followthrough no arrow. Neck and torso do not bulge; don't enlarge shoulders to express power.
Maintain exactly the same foot soles, knees and bow hand coordinates within each row across the four poses. Bowstring must be a clearly visible clean dark warm brown continuous line physically joining both bow tips in every frame; for drawn poses it bends to the draw hand, after release it returns relaxed across both tips. No broken/dotted string. No arrows after release, no flying projectiles, no magic.
Complete4x3 sheet only on absolutely uniform bright magenta #FF00FF background. No floor, shadows, checkerboard, labels, borders, texture or gradients; leave generous margins around every pose including long spear and raised bow. No clipped equipment.
correction_prompt:
Make ONE equipment consistency correction to this exact 4x3 sprite sheet; preserve every character face, body proportion, pose, foot coordinate, hand coordinate, color, contour, grid and overall scale exactly.
All twelve bows must be the SAME simple plain dark-brown curved wooden bow: remove the tiny golden spiral/curled knob ornaments at BOTH bow tips and replace them with clean slender tapering dark-brown wooden endpoints. No gold caps, curls or knobs on bows. Their size, overall arc, hand grip and endpoint positions must remain unchanged. Keep strings strongly visible as continuous fine warm-dark lines joining the two exact bow tips and, on anticipation/full draw columns1-2, passing through the drawing hand. On release/followthrough columns3-4, a relaxed straight continuous string joins both tips with NO residual arrow. Retain one arrow on first two rows draw frames and three arrows on volley draw frames. Do not remove golden character armor, clasps, helmet, greaves, shield border or spear details; the correction concerns ONLY the bow-tip ornaments.
Output the same complete4x3 sprite sheet on unchanged uniform solid magenta #FF00FF, with all current margins and framing.
selected_usage: bow_piercing_S/bow_death_S/volley_S four dedicated source regions each
runtime_processing: Optional magenta-edge RGB recovery on selected S arc frames only, radius2/excess12/protected red R>=2B; alpha and original source bytes unchanged. See pipeline alignment and manifest source_report.edge_despill.
